propositions: DC backend has no unit-level value-pinning test coverage while Cloud's test_backend_characterization.py pins every map entry and boundary; test_backend_contract.py only asserts shape presence, not correctness of values

The shared OutboundFieldMapper body is exercised only through AdfCodec but never through WikiTextCodec, leaving DC composition regressions (dropped length fit, lost type guards, mis-mapped status/priority) undetectable

DC's _backend() seam cannot observe the real probe classifier because FakeTransport.probe_remote returns ProbeBranch.UNREACHABLE unconditionally; probe pins must instead call classify_probe_response directly or construct JiraDataCenterTransport over a stub client

DC's DEFAULT_RESOLVED_STATUSES is byte-for-byte identical to Cloud's RESOLVED_STATUS_NAMES, making a pin that asserts DC binds its own set vacuous at defaults; the pin must use a custom non-default set to discriminate the two paths

The mapper's fit-then-normalize ordering is load-bearing but not pinnable through WikiTextCodec since normalize_outbound is the identity; ordering assertion remains AdfCodec's responsibility while DC path pins the length fit boundary value itself
Existing test_backend_characterization.py Cloud assertions must pass unedited after parametrization; a split file is the fallback if parametrization obscures Cloud pins
